20.1 Vendor shall defend, indemnify, and hold harmless Customer, its Affiliates, and their directors, officers, employees, and agents from each third-party claim and resulting damages, settlements, judgments, penalties, costs, and reasonable attorneys' fees arising from an allegation that the Services or Deliverables infringe or misappropriate an intellectual property right.</quote>
<parameter name="rationale">Section 20 meets the preferred position in full. Vendor defends and indemnifies Customer and its Affiliates against third-party claims alleging that the Services or Deliverables infringe or misappropriate intellectual property (20.1), and against claims arising from Vendor's breach of Applicable Law, unauthorized access to or disclosure of Customer Data caused by Vendor, and Vendor's gross negligence, wilful misconduct or fraud (20.2). The procedure requires prompt notice, reasonable cooperation at the indemnifying Party's expense and control of the defence, with settlement-consent protection (20.4). Customer's indemnity is narrow, limited to unmodified Customer-supplied material used strictly as authorized and Customer's violation of Applicable Law (20.3). Beyond preferred, 20.5 adds procure, modify, replace and refund remedies, and 21.3 makes indemnification obligations Excluded Claims so the indemnity is not squeezed by the liability cap; the fallback three times annual fees super-cap would be less favourable to us and is not sought. No redline required.
